summary.text: Brian Miller is the Democratic nominee for Montana's 2nd Congressional District. A Helena attorney originally from Florida who has lived in Montana since the late 1990s, he handles civil cases for small businesses, consumers and individuals. He won the June 2 Democratic primary.

paragraphs.text: Brian Miller was born in 1972 in Cleveland, Ohio, according to the Daily Montanan, and holds a bachelor's degree from Emory University and a law degree from the University of Montana.
The Glendive Ranger-Review describes him as originally from Florida and a Montana resident since the late 1990s.

Miller has practiced law in Helena since at least 2010 with the firm Morrison, Sherwood, Wilson and Deola, and he also runs a private practice handling civil cases for small businesses, consumers and other individuals against insurance companies, banks and others.
He has two children, whom he told the Ranger-Review are his greatest motivation for running.
Miller launched his campaign in late 2025 and won the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary, defeating Sam Lux and state Sen. Jonathan Windy Boy, who had suspended his campaign.
He is challenging Republican Rep. Troy Downing.
